THEY SHOW CRICKET!!!
Aug 2019
Having had to resort to watching The Ashes through dodgy internet streams, our arrival in Da Nang offered new hope that we may be able to find an actual bar/pub to watch the cricket properly in Vietnam.

Universal pub was exactly that place! It has two large screens showing sport, a pool table, a darts board and a great friendly atmosphere. 

The food was very good too, if you want something western. The nachos were fantastic and the pasta bolognese was also wonderful. 

Overall, a fantastic evening and a great place to chat to other sports fans,

Nice place for a drink and hang out
Apr 2019 • Friends
Was walking along the riverfront and decided to stop in this bar for a drink. It's a nice bar with a great view of the river. There is a pool table as well as a dart board if interested in games.
The bar has a good selection of beers and cocktails, and the prices are reasonable. The server was efficient but made no effort to be friendly or welcoming, but was attentive.
Looked to have a good food menu though had already had dinner. Looks to be one of the nicer bars on Bach Dang street which has many bars.
The crowd was a mix of younger westerners and a few younger local ladies when I was there, which may not be typical crowd.
Definitely worth a visit.
